The test `['pandas.tests.indexes.datetimes.test_to_period.TestToPeriod.test_to_period_infer()']` fails because the `DatetimeArray.to_period()` method is not correctly handling the conversion of a `DatetimeArray` to a `PeriodArray`. The error occurs when trying to access an attribute on a `NoneType` object, specifically when attempting to call `.n` on the frequency object. This suggests that the frequency conversion logic might be failing to produce a valid `PeriodArray`.

Based on the provided code snippet, the issue seems to occur in the `_from_datetime64` method within `pandas/core/arrays/period.py`. Specifically, the line `if freq.n <= 0:` is attempting to access an attribute on a `NoneType` object. This implies that the frequency conversion might not be successful.

To fix this issue, you should investigate the logic that determines and converts the frequency in the `_from_datetime64` method. Ensure that the frequency conversion handles all possible cases correctly and does not return `None`.

```
pandas.core.arrays.period.PeriodArray._from_datetime64
pandas.core.indexes.datetimes.DatetimeIndex.to_period
```
